responsibility: Contains the main RTL machine description for the C-SKY backend, defining the target’s core instruction patterns, attributes, unspec codes, register-number constants, expanders, and assembly output rules. It ties together constraints, predicates, FPU and DSP subdescriptions, and per-core scheduler files, while providing the central patterns for moves, TLS/PIC materialization, constant-pool entries, switch dispatch, indexing, byte-swap, and other fundamental instruction selection and lowering behavior for C-SKY code generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative machine-description file for C-SKY: it defines register-number constants, unspec/attribute enums, expanders, instruction patterns, and asm output templates that drive RTL recognition and instruction selection. Unlike csky.cc it is not C++ hook implementation code, unlike csky.h it is not a general target macro header, and unlike csky.opt it does not participate in option parsing.
